Description: Peptide from OpenProt database.
unique_to_* - proteotypic to protein of type canonical/non-canonical; shared_in_* - shared between proteins of same type; shared_btw_can_noncan - shared between proteins of both types.
List of proteins the database_peptide matches to.
The mass shift of at least one PSM of database_peptide is isobaric to amino acid substitution.
List of dataset accessions in PRIDE Archive, where database_peptide was detected.
List of spectrum titles matched to database_peptide.
List of scan numbers matched to database_peptide.
List of MS-run files, where database_peptide was detected.
List of observed retention times of spectra matched to database_peptide.
List of precursor charges matched to database_peptide.
List of modifications matched to PSMs. First element is position in peptide, second - corresponding residue in peptide, third - monoisotopic mass.
Fraction of database_peptide PSMs with mass shift isobaric to amino acid substitution.
The non-redundant set of modifications_masses.
Residues inherent to mass shift isobaric to amino acid substitution (according to unimod).
Positions on database_peptide that correspond to residues_to_sub.
List of residue pairs that are potential amino acid substitutions. First residue is to be substituted by the second residue in the pair.

One of the proteins prom column "proteins".

Position in genome (codon), new residue and reference residue of peptides_w1sub.
DNA strand, that encodes the protein from column proteins_explode. 1 - forward, -1 - reverse.
Chromosome, that encodes the protein from column proteins_explode.
Gene accession, that encodes the protein from column proteins_explode.
Nucleotides on forward strand in genomic position indicated in column saav_info_triplet.
Nucleotides on reverse strand in genomic position indicated in column saav_info_triplet. If strand column ==1, the values in saav_info_refcod and saav_info_refcod_rev are identical.

The nucleotide(s) found in gnomAD on genomic position of saav_exp_mut (position is taken from saav_info_triplet, or same as saav_pos_mut). the nucleotides correspond to forward strand.
